name: lld-practice-platform
description: Practise Low-Level Design, submit a structured design, get rubric-based feedback that quotes your own words.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "tsx watch --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/server.ts" "vite --config web/vite.config.ts"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
